idea-plugin.name: AI Crawler Rules
idea-plugin.description:
Checks robots.txt line by line and says what each AI crawler token actually controls - training, AI-search citation, or user fetch - and which lines silently do nothing.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → AI Crawler Rules: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/robots-txt-ai-crawler-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/robots-txt-ai-crawler-audit

action.text: AI Crawler Rules: Check This File
action.description: Run AI Crawler Rules on the file in the editor
